results.title: Moody's (MCO) Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
results.content: * **Insurance Solutions ARR Growth**: 9%, affected by a one-time account loss and strong comparables in the first half of the prior year; pipeline is expected to support at least high single-digit growth rates as we head into the second half of 2025. Now one of the deep currents driving demand in Moody's ratings we've discussed a good deal on recent calls is the continued growth and evolution of the private credit markets. Now continuing the trend from the first quarter, private credit is an important driver of growth in ratings. The trends of transaction revenue against issuance growth imply a favorable issuance mix this quarter, from corporate finance, structured finance, and TPIF, and the contribution of private credit. That said, our new business pipeline is building nicely, growing at a double-digit pace, and we expect it will support at least high single-digit growth rates as we head into the second half of the year.
